integrity: The analytic proof and independent numerical checker are supplied. Numerical checks corroborate but do not prove the theorem. No formal proof or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The puncture asymptotic holds at each fixed interior center, not uniformly as center approaches the outer boundary. No uniqueness or full classification of transition radii is shown. The classical disk law, fixed-point containment I(r), and semicircle lemma are established prior components, not new results. Historical priority and correctness await independent validation.
title: A sign-changing puncture response in Sylvester's four-point problem for disks
